home.title: Tegeera enkola. Weeyise mu ngeri ey'obukuumi.
home.subhead: Amasomo ag'obukuumi ku yintaneeti ag'obwerere eri amasomero mu Disitulikiti y'e Butambala, Uganda.
home.intro: Kebera engeri enkola eza bulijjo gye zikolamu, we ziyinza okulemererwa, n'ebyo abayizi n'abasomesa bye bayinza okukola okuzifuula ez'obukuumi.
home.acknowledgement: Supported by the Internet Society Fellowship Program.
home.introTitle: Tekinologiya wa bulijjo alina enkola emukoleramu.
home.introText: Yiga engeri enkola ezo gye zikuuma amawulire, we ziyinza okuba obuzibu, n'engeri dizayini ennungi n'ebikolwa ebya bulijjo gye biyinza okuzifuula ez'obukuumi.
home.lessonsTitle: Ebirowoozo mukaaga. Ensi ya digito ennungi era ey'obukuumi.
home.topicThreatText: Tegeera ekirina okukuumibwa n'ensonga lwaki kikulu.
home.topicAuthenticationText: Kebera engeri akawunti gye zimanya oyo ayingira.
home.topicPhishingText: Manyira engeri obwesige gye buyinza okukozesebwa obubi mu bubaka.
about.title: Ebikwata ku CyberSmart Butambala
about.intro: Pulojekiti ey'obwerere era eggule ey'okusomesa obukuumi ku yintaneeti mu masomero aga pulayimale ne siniya mu Disitulikiti y'e Butambala, Uganda.
about.background: Obuweereza obwa digito buli mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, naye enkola ezibukoleramu tezitegeerekeka bulungi. CyberSmart Butambala eyamba abayizi n'abasomesa okutegeera enkola ezo n'okusalawo mu ngeri ey'obukuumi.
about.community: Pulojekiti essira eriteeka ku masomero n'ebitundu mu Disitulikiti y'e Butambala, nga mw'otwalidde ne Lukalu Senior Secondary School. Emirimu n'enkolagana n'amasomero bijja kukakasibwa nga tebinnateekebwa mu bikozesebwa ebya bonna.
about.focus: Amasomo gano gagoberera ekkubo lya Systems Security erya Internet Society Fellowship Program. Gagatta ebyokulabirako ebya bulijjo n'ebintu ng'okulowooza ku bulabe, okukakasa omukozesa, obutuufu bw'amawulire, n'ebyama.
lessons.title: Amasomo g'Obukuumi bw'Enkola
lessons.intro: Ebitundu mukaaga eby'okusomesa bigatta ebyokulabirako ebya digito ebimanyiddwa n'amagezi g'obukuumi bw'enkola.
lessons.englishNote: Ebirimu mu masomo biri mu Lungereza mu nkyusa eno esooka. Okuvvuunula amasomo mu Luganda kugenda mu maaso.
lessons.englishOnlyTitle: Okuvvuunula mu Luganda kugenda mu maaso
lessons.eyebrow: Yiga enkola eziri emabega wa ssirini
downloads.title: Ebiwandiiko eby'obwerere
downloads.intro: Ebiwandiiko eby'okukozesa mu kibiina bijja kuteekebwa wano nga bimaze okwekebejjebwa n'okutegekebwa.
downloads.openLicense: Ebiwandiiko byonna bya bwerere era biri wansi wa layisinsi eggule (CC BY-SA 4.0).
downloads.note: Fayiro zino ze byokulabirako eby'okujjuzaamu okutuusa ng'ebiwandiiko eby'okufulumya bitegekeddwa.
license.title: Ebiwandiiko ne pulogulaamu eggule
license.intro: CyberSmart Butambala egenderera okuteeka ebikozesebwa mu kuyiga mu lujjudde basobole okubiddamu okukozesa n'okubirongoosa.
license.materials: Ebiwandiiko by'amasomo n'ebikozesebwa mu kuyiga biri wansi wa Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0). Waayo ettendo erisaanidde, teeka enkolagana ku layisinsi, era otegeeze oba nga waliwo ky'okozeeko. Ebikyusiddwa birina okukozesa layisinsi y'emu.
license.code: Koodi y'omukutu guno eri wansi wa layisinsi ya MIT.
license.reviewNote: Ebyokulabirako n'ebiwandiiko eby'ekiseera birina okwekebejjebwa nga tebinnasaasanyizibwa ng'ebikozesebwa ebitongole ebya pulojekiti.
accessibility.title: Ekirangiriro ky'okutuukirirwa
accessibility.intro: CyberSmart Butambala egenderera okufuula ebikozesebwa byayo eby'okuyiga okutuukirirwa abantu bangi nga bwe kisoboka.
accessibility.commitment: Omukutu gukoleddwa nga gukozesa HTML etegeerekeka, okutuukirirwa n'akakiiko, ekifo ekirabika we wali, langi ezisomeka, ebigambo ebiyinza okugaziwa, emitwe gy'emiko egy'enjawulo, n'okussa ekitiibwa mu kwewala entambula ezikyukakyuka. Tufuba okutuukana ne WCAG 2.1 AA; kino kye kigendererwa, si kukakasibwa okuva eri abakugu abetongodde.
accessibility.known: Fayiro ezimu ez'okuwanula za byokulabirako, era okuvvuunula amasomo mu Luganda kukyagenda mu maaso. Tujja kwekebejja engeri ebiwandiiko eby'enkomerero gye biyinza okutuukirirwa nga tebinnateekebwa mu lujjudde.
accessibility.feedback: Bw'oba olina ekitundu ky'omukutu kino ekikuzibuwalira okukozesa, tuukirira ttiimu ya pulojekiti ng'okozesa ekifo kya email ekiri mu wansi w'omukutu. Endagiriro ya email ejja kuteekebwawo nga omukutu tegunnatongozebwa.
